title: PROD: TEL - Cascadia
description: Telemetry board: link health, GPS position/status/motion, IMU. Health and faults first, detail below.

panels.title: TEL: Fault banner
panels.description: Red: a fault bit is set now (names listed). Orange: something is wrong that is not a fault bit: TEL link lost / rebooted; GPS satellites; GPS no 3D fix; CAN bus load. Blank when everything is normal.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "strings"
st = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELDiagnostics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "TELWatchdogReset" or r["_field"] == "IMUReadFail" or r["_field"] == "IMUWriteFail" or r["_field"] == "GPSReadFail" or r["_field"] == "GPSWriteFail" or r["_field"] == "MCUOvertemp" or r["_field"] == "MCUUndervoltage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> toInt()
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "now")
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: r._field, _value: if r.now > 0 then 2 else if r._value > 0 then 1 else 0}))
  |> last()
  |> group()
act = st |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 2) |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_field")
wl = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL" and r["class"] == "TELTimeSinceBootup")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value:
      if float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 > 3.0 then "TEL link lost"
      else if float(v: r._value) < 60.0 then "TEL rebooted " + string(v: int(v: r._value)) + " s ago"
      else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
w0 = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL" and r["class"] == "TELGpsStatus" and r["_field"] == "GpsSatsUsed")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value < 4 then "GPS satellites" + ": " + string(v: int(v: r._value)) + "" else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
w1 = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL" and r["class"] == "TELGpsStatus" and r["_field"] == "GpsFixType")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value != 3 and r._value != 4 then "GPS no 3D fix" + "" else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
w2 = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL" and r["class"] == "CANBusLoad" and r["_field"] == "BusLoad")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value >= 70 then "CAN bus load" + ": " + string(v: int(v: r._value)) + "%" else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
warn = union(tables: [wl, w0, w1, w2]) |> group() |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != "") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
f = if length(arr: act) > 0 then "ACTIVE FAULT: " + strings.joinStr(arr: act, v: ", ") else ""
w = if length(arr: warn) > 0 then "WARNING: " + strings.joinStr(arr: warn, v: ", ") else ""
msg = if f != "" and w != "" then f + "   |   " + w else f + w
array.from(rows: [{_value: msg}]) |> yield(name: "banner")

panels.title: TEL: Link (s since last frame)
panels.description: Time since the last TELTimeSinceBootup frame reached InfluxDB (looks back 1 h). Red after 3 s: the board, CAN or the radio link is down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELTimeSinceBootup")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "Last frame", _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> yield(name: "age")

panels.title: TEL: Uptime (s)

panels.title: TEL: Faults
panels.description: TELDiagnostics bits (max per window, so a single faulted frame is never averaged away). Per row: OK, FAULT (red) while set, CLEARED (yellow) once it has faulted in the time range shown. Zoom the time range past an old fault to clear the yellow.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELDiagnostics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "TELWatchdogReset" or r["_field"] == "IMUReadFail" or r["_field"] == "IMUWriteFail" or r["_field"] == "GPSReadFail" or r["_field"] == "GPSWriteFail" or r["_field"] == "MCUOvertemp" or r["_field"] == "MCUUndervoltage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "now")
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])

  |> yield(name: "fault_state")

panels.title: TEL: GPS track
panels.description: GpsLatitude/GpsLongitude (deg). TEL only sends a position when the receiver has a fix.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELGpsPosition")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "GpsLatitude" or r["_field"] == "GpsLongitude")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "GpsLatitude", "GpsLongitude"])
  |> yield(name: "track")
